scene_before.dominant_activity: Witch reciting a prophetic curse on the beach
scene_before.summary: A haggard, ash-smeared woman sitting beneath a weathered seaside tree mutters ominous prophecies about sea rising and drowning them all. The young boy frolics in the ocean waves before running directly toward the camera with a sinister grin. The main title card 'Mandar' slams onto the screen.
scene_before.opening_gist: A strange wild woman mutters by a dried tree.
scene_before.closing_gist: The title card 'Mandar' is revealed against a black screen.

scene_after.dominant_activity: Surreal decorated bed scene on the beach
scene_after.summary: Episode title 'Blood Will Have Blood' displays over an empty beach where a bridal canopy bed sits. Mandar walks across the sand dressed in festive red garb, approaching a veiled bride holding a black cat. When he tries to touch her, the veil reveals the creepy witch laughing hysterically, sending Mandar running away in terror as an SUV splashes into the sea.
scene_after.opening_gist: A flower-decorated bridal canopy bed stands on the desolate beach.
scene_after.closing_gist: An SUV races away through the shallow ocean water.
